headline: Tyler Technologies (TYL) Just Completed Tennessee’s Largest Statewide Tax Cloud Rollout
summary: Tennessee has completed a statewide cloud deployment of Tyler Technologies' Enterprise Assessment & Tax solution. The project was carried out for the Tennessee Comptroller of the Treasury and now supports hundreds of property assessment users across the state. Tyler Technologies (NYSE:TYL) focuses on software and services for the public sector, and this Tennessee rollout is in that core business.
